traps.trap: Absent from both bundled Indian instrument masters
traps.detail: Listed 2026-08-06. The app's BSE master was generated 2026-06-09 and the NSE master 2026-06-05 - both predate the listing. JNPR/544853 cannot be in either. The US master has no JNPR row either (see T8).
traps.consequence: Resolution must fall through to a live lookup or fail honestly. A resolver that treats master-absence as 'no such security' will deny a 15,000-crore mainboard listing exists.

traps.trap: Five mutually inconsistent P/E values on one day
traps.detail: 572 (screener consolidated), 373.38 (businesstoday, FY26 consolidated PAT), 290.1 (derived, consolidated TTM), 280.20 (stockanalysis BSE page), 248.12 (stockanalysis NSE page, standalone profit / consolidated market cap). Spread 2.3x.
traps.consequence: Any single-source P/E is defensible and wrong. The only honest render is the basis alongside the number.

traps.trap: One aggregator serves two contradictory pages for the same company
traps.detail: stockanalysis.com's NSE page (/quote/nse/JNPR/) and BSE page (/quote/bom/544853/) disagree on 52-week low (204.00 vs 232.10), 52-week high (282.00 vs 282.50), market cap (150.87B vs 146.35B), P/E (248.12 vs 280.20) and as-of date (18 Sep vs 17 Sep).
traps.consequence: Cross-source agreement counts for nothing if both hits come from the same origin via different exchange routes. A dedup keyed on domain will call this 'corroborated'.

traps.trap: Market cap computed on a stale price, displayed next to a fresh one
traps.detail: TradingView shows price 265.15 and market cap 146.52B. 568,998,442 x 257.50 (the previous day's BSE close) = 146.52B exactly. The market cap is one session behind the price, with no as-of marker.
traps.consequence: A 2.9% understatement that is invisible to any check short of recomputing cap from shares x price. Reproducible arithmetic, not a rounding artefact.

traps.detail: Every source publishes a '52-week' high/low for a stock that has existed since 2026-08-06. The low (232.10, dated 2026-08-06) is simply the listing-day low. One source (stockanalysis NSE) publishes 204.00, which is below both the listing-day low and the INR 225 issue price and is corroborated by nothing.
traps.consequence: A '% off 52-week low' or range-position indicator is meaningless here and will look confidently precise while being structurally undefined.

traps.trap: A named aggregator's net-worth figure is off by ~28x
traps.detail: chittorgarh's IPO financials table gives consolidated Net Worth FY2026 = INR 122.89 crore. ICRA's audited Total-outside-liabilities/tangible-net-worth of 4.7x against RHP total assets of 19,538.45 crore solves to TNW = 19,538.45 / 5.7 = INR 3,428 crore, and the company states net worth of INR 3,463 crore at 2026-06-30. Standalone equity + reserves = 489 + 2,939 = INR 3,428 crore, the same figure.
traps.consequence: A book value per share built on 122.89 gives INR 2.16 and a P/B of 123x instead of 2.9x - a 42x error presented as a clean number. Three independent cross-checks converge on ~3,43x crore; the 122.89 does not.

traps.trap: Standalone net profit EXCEEDS consolidated net profit, and ROE flips sign
traps.detail: FY2026: standalone PAT 61 vs consolidated PAT 40.5. screener's own pages give ROE +0.43% consolidated and -0.58% standalone for the same company on the same day.
traps.consequence: The usual heuristic 'consolidated >= standalone, pick the larger' produces the wrong basis here, and a sign-sensitive render (red/green, loss-making flag) flips on a basis choice the user never made.

traps.trap: Ticker collision with a DELISTED US large-cap
traps.detail: US JNPR = Juniper Networks, Inc. stockanalysis.com states: 'Jul 2, 2025 - JNPR was delisted (reason: acquired by HPE)', a $14 billion acquisition. Decades of news, charts and analyst coverage sit under JNPR as a US networking company.
traps.consequence: A web-search-backed agent asked about 'JNPR' will surface Juniper Networks/HPE material with high confidence and zero Indian relevance. The security is gone but the corpus is not.

traps.trap: Name collision with a live NSE-listed company at a near-identical price
traps.detail: NSE symbol JUNIPER = Juniper Hotels Limited (BSE 544129), a Hyatt-affiliated luxury hotel owner, trading at INR 224 with a market cap of INR 4,991 crore. JNPR's IPO issue price was INR 225 - one rupee apart.
traps.consequence: Fuzzy name matching on 'Juniper' lands on a hotel company; a numeric sanity check on price will not catch it, because the prices are within 0.4%.

traps.trap: Pre-IPO per-share history is not comparable
traps.detail: Standalone equity capital went INR 26 crore (Mar-2024) -> INR 489 crore (Mar-2025), then INR 569 crore post-IPO. Standalone EPS therefore reads 8.88 (FY24) -> 0.89 (FY25) -> 1.26 (FY26): an apparent 90% collapse that is purely a share-count restructuring.
traps.consequence: Any EPS growth chart, CAGR or 'earnings declined' narrative drawn across FY24/FY25 is fiction unless restated.

traps.trap: Balance sheet is 44 days stale by INR 1,800 crore
traps.detail: Net worth: INR 3,463 crore (2026-06-30) -> ~INR 5,200 crore post-IPO (August 2026). Net debt/equity: 3.24x -> ~2.16x. Every filed balance sheet predates the IPO proceeds.
traps.consequence: Book value, P/B, ROE and leverage computed from the most recent FILED statement are all wrong by the size of the IPO, and will stay wrong until the Q2 FY2027 results in late October 2026.

traps.detail: FY2026 Total Income 804.93 vs Operating Income 718.9 (INR 86 crore of other income). Q1 FY2027 Total Income 324 vs Operating Income 291.2. screener and ICRA report the operating line; chittorgarh and the company's headline report the total line.
traps.consequence: Revenue-based multiples (P/S, EV/Sales) swing 12% on the definition. Compounding trap: the standalone FY2026 sales figure (INR 324 crore) is NUMERICALLY IDENTICAL to the consolidated Q1 FY2027 total income (INR 324 crore) - a collision that makes a mis-picked cell look plausible.

traps.trap: Operational capacity moves weekly and one aggregator confuses it with total portfolio
traps.detail: Operational: 2,409 MWp (2026-06-30) -> 2,575 MWp (2026-08-27) -> 2,689 MWp (2026-09-16). Total portfolio: 11,216 MWp + 8,989 MWh BESS. stockanalysis's BSE page describes 'an operational portfolio of 11.2 GW capacity' - the TOTAL portfolio (including under-construction, contracted and merely awarded projects) relabelled as operational, a 4.2x overstatement.
traps.consequence: Any cached capacity figure is wrong within days, and the one qualitative figure an aggregator volunteered is wrong by 4x.

traps.detail: CIN changed U40100DL2011PLC228318 -> L40100DL2011PLC228318 on 2026-09-02. Filings published before that date (including the 2026-08-27 Q1 press release) still carry the old U-prefix CIN on the letterhead. The legal name also changed from 'Private Limited' at an unrecorded date.
traps.consequence: Keying an entity on CIN across a document set spanning August-September 2026 splits one company into two.
